slides.title: Meet Pim
slides.text: Pim the owl runs the post office in Netville. Pim's job is to get every message to the right house.
slides.alt: Pim opens the Netville map: houses, roads and the first message waiting to be delivered.

slides.title: Too big to send
slides.text: A picture is too big to send in one piece. The network cuts it into small pieces called packets and gives each one a number.
slides.alt: Break It Up: a message too big for one trip is cut into small numbered packets at the post office.

slides.title: Many roads
slides.text: Each packet can take a different road through many post offices, called routers. If a road closes, a packet just takes another one.
slides.alt: Many Roads: the town map offers more than one road between the same houses, and a closed road is not the end.

slides.title: Back in order
slides.text: Packets can arrive mixed up. The numbers tell the other end how to put the picture back together.
slides.alt: Packets are on the roads of Netville, each carrying its number, so the far end can rebuild the message in order.

words.means: a small numbered piece of a message
computers joined by roads, so they can send messages
a post office that passes packets along
put the pieces back together in order

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Packet Post at Break It Up and finish all 5 levels, then play all 4 levels of Many Roads. Watch the number on every packet.
slides.alt: Pim opens the Netville map: houses, roads and the first message waiting to be delivered.
